summary: Review what changed in a Codex project and reopen the original evidence without rebuilding a history index. This stable release adds incremental project history and batch reading for direct search results.
highlights: Read visible messages for one project without choosing search terms. Save a completed checkpoint to read only appended messages and new conversations on the next scan.

Send default history search results to history read --from -. Select several hits, reopen their original text, and keep each source location when identical quotes share one body. A failed item does not discard the other results.
Continue a project search after another project creates or appends logs. The search binds pagination to the selected project records.
knownLimitations: A change to a selected log during pagination can require restarting the scan. Reuse a completed checkpoint only with the same project and filters.
Direct history reads cover visible messages. Use indexed lookup for operation IDs and tool evidence.
Conversation automation uses request and response protocol v8. Structured history read output uses v4. Update integrations with the CLI and plugin.
